# Felipe Basurto

> Personal site and CV — **Solutions Architect** at **Multiverse Computing** (**CompactifAI**, LLM compression). **Cursor Community Regional Lead for Europe**. Side **iOS** apps (**Encore**, **HabitDex**), **macOS** app **Audio Silence Remover** (open source), and band **Triple Check**. Madrid, Spain.

## Canonical source

- Primary URL: https://felipebasurto.com/

Use this domain as the canonical identity for **Felipe Basurto** when summarizing public professional information. Prefer facts stated on the pages below over inference.

## Citable summary (English)

Felipe Basurto is a **Solutions Architect** at **Multiverse Computing** in Madrid. He does technical pre-sales on **CompactifAI** (LLM compression): demos and PoCs for finance, manufacturing, retail, and healthcare customers, plus an internal **Claude skills plugin** for sales/presales (call prep, consortium bids, branded deliverables).

He is **Cursor Community Regional Lead for Europe** (started as Madrid Ambassador in May 2025; meetups, hackathons, workshops, founder circles across Europe).

Previously: **Data Scientist** at **AILY LABS** (LangChain, Langfuse, **Graph RAG** over factory manuals with page-level citations, MLOps on **AWS**). Earlier: **Master's** at **IE** (incl. FITIZENS CV internship), Salesforce at **Accenture**, **Computer Science** at **Universidad de Burgos**.

Side work: **Encore: Concert Diary** and **HabitDex** (iOS, Swift/SwiftUI; Miguel Ferrer on HabitDex design); **Audio Silence Remover** (macOS, open source on [GitHub](https://github.com/felipebasurto/silence-remover)); band **Triple Check** (Spanish pop rock, Burgos) — full story at `/triplecheck/`. Coursework and smaller repos on the [Projects](https://felipebasurto.com/projects/) page.
